description: Standing query, zero results expected: no successful AWS change in the last three days without an attributable principal -- a name or ARN -- in its CloudTrail record. api.read_only exists from 2026-10-07 00:25 UTC, so the window fills over three days

params.query: SELECT dt, actor.user.type AS type, api.service.name AS service, api.operation AS operation, count(*) AS events FROM normalized_events WHERE source='aws' AND dt >= date_format(date_add('day', -2, current_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AND status = 'Success' AND api.read_only = false AND actor.user.type <> 'AWSService' AND coalesce(actor.user.name, '') = '' AND coalesce(actor.user.uid, '') = '' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 50

matrix_rows.gap: AWS changes only; GitHub commits carry GitHub's account attribution, unsigned (SVC-VRI verify 3), and GCP's changes are not in the corpus.
